summary.zh: 同样以魔杖和精神分流为核心，再加上更长的暗言术：痛与抗打断。
summary.en: The same wand and Spirit Tap core, with a longer Shadow Word: Pain and pushback protection on top.

scenario.zh: 10–20 级，用暗言术：痛配合魔杖单刷
scenario.en: Levels 10–20, solo damage with Shadow Word: Pain and a wand

pros.zh: 强化暗言术：痛让持续时间延长 6 秒，一次施放覆盖整场战斗，单位伤害的法力消耗大幅下降。
pros.en: Improved Shadow Word: Pain adds 6 seconds of duration, so one cast covers a whole fight and costs far less Mana per point of damage.

pros.zh: 魔杖专精提供 25% 魔杖伤害；持续伤害跳动期间就用魔杖输出。
pros.en: Wand Specialization adds 25% wand damage; you wand while the damage over time ticks.

pros.zh: 每次击杀后的精神分流，让你可以直接拉下一只怪而不是坐下喝水。
pros.en: Spirit Tap after every kill is what lets you pull the next target instead of drinking.

pros.zh: 打 PvP 时，把最后 2 点从暮光专注换成昏阙；如果问题出在射程，则选暗影延伸。
pros.en: In PvP, spend the last two points on Blackout instead of Twilight Focus; Shadow Reach is the pick if range is what keeps failing you.

provenance.source: wowhandbook.com recommended builds, beta client data
provenance.notes: Beta build 1.60.1.70425 recommendations; may change before launch.
